meta.name: cyber-owasp-review
meta.description: Map application security findings to OWASP Top 10 categories and generate remediation checklists. Use for normalized AppSec review outputs and category-level prioritization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将安全发现映射到OWASP Top 10并生成修复清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要规范化应用安全评审输出并按类别确定优先级
copy.tagline_en: Map security findings to OWASP Top 10 and generate remediation checklists
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need normalized AppSec review outputs and category-level prioritization

howto.what: Claude 会将安全扫描结果映射到 OWASP Top 10 分类，并按分类和严重程度汇总，生成修复检查清单。
howto.when: 当你提供应用安全扫描结果、测试报告或审查发现时，Claude 会触发此技能。

say.text: 请帮我将这份渗透测试报告映射到 OWASP 分类。
say.note: Claude 会分析报告并输出分类结果。

say.text: 生成 SQL 注入相关的修复检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会输出针对该分类的修复步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude maps security findings to OWASP Top 10 categories, aggregates by category and severity, and generates remediation checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide application security scan results, test reports, or review findings.

say_en.text: Map this penetration test report to OWASP categories.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and output category mappings.

say_en.text: Generate a remediation checklist for SQL injection.
say_en.note: Claude will output steps for that category.
